mu_name_from: MuMain ZzzInventory.cpp:1704 -- 'Box of Kundun +N', MU's 14, 11 at levels 8-12 (N = level - 7), from Data\Item\MagicBox08.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:979), Eldobox.jpg on all 44 triangles. Its tier is its plus here: +1 to +3 (docs/kundun-box.md section 1).
why_this_one: The Golden Dragon's raid: it leaves five, +1 to +3, round its corpse, the 2009 renewal's (WZ gObjMonster.cpp:4183-4335; docs/golden-dragon-raid.md section 1, Loot).
profile_note: As the Firecracker: a small painted sheet on a made object seen close.
tells: Throw it and you may receive some Zen or items.
tells_from: MU's own tooltip for its boxes (docs/kundun-box-sources.md section 4.2).

stats.note: MU's 14,11 at levels 8-12; here a row of its own at a free number, its tier its plus (invention).

geometry_scale_from: MuMain draws MODEL_EVENT + 10 at Scale 0.2 on the ground (ZzzObject.cpp:5723, ItemObjectAttribute); MagicBox08.bmd is authored a chest five times that, so its vertices are written here at 0.2 of MuExtract's export.
sheet_from: Data/Item/Eldobox.OZJ (32x32) from MuMain's bin/Data/Item, which MagicBox08.bmd names Eldobox.jpg -- WebZen's 'Eldorado box': red lacquered boards, gold studs and scrolled gold trim.
material_note: Lacquered boards: the library's hardwood. The studs and trim are paint on the sheet.
